proofUses.reason: The real part of the fractional-linear force identity transports arbitrary interior and boundary marks. The remaining Itô drift is exactly the old-target force; the destination starting point is required to be finite.
The reflected strip force is the real part of coth. Exponentiation gives the mixed chordal drift and mark equations, including both endpoints, under the balance condition.
Equal added weights at the strip ends cancel in the original driver and restore the balance. Composition gives arbitrary-weight half-plane and disk laws, retaining the destination target stop.
